rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Ghost Student Financial Aid Fraud — Shared Device Detection")`
`comment("Detects multiple FAFSA applications from same device fingerprint")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
  application_source="fafsa"
| stats dc(student_id) AS distinct_students, count AS application_count,
    values(student_id) AS student_ids, values(source_ip) AS source_ips,
    values(institution_id) AS institutions
    by device_fingerprint
| where distinct_students >= 3
| eval risk_level = case(
    distinct_students > 10, "critical",
    distinct_students > 5, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| sort - distinct_students

`comment("Splunk SPL for Ghost Student Financial Aid Fraud — Shared Bank Account Detection")`
`comment("Detects multiple student IDs disbursing to the same bank account")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
  disbursement_type="financial_aid"
| stats dc(student_id) AS distinct_students, sum(disbursement_amount) AS total_disbursed,
    values(student_id) AS student_ids, values(disbursement_date) AS disbursement_dates,
    values(institution_id) AS institutions
    by bank_routing_number, bank_account_number
| where distinct_students >= 2
| eval risk_level = case(
    distinct_students > 5, "critical",
    distinct_students > 2, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| sort - distinct_students
rules.title: DL-0169: Ghost Student Financial Aid Fraud — Multi-Signal Botnet Enrollment Detection (SPLUNK)
